title: Curated Interior Collection
description: Welcome to Yogesh Chavan Associates — where every piece tells a story and every design is a journey. A curated world of exquisite décor that transforms houses into homes with soul.

chapters.title: Marble Feature Wall
chapters.text: A living room anchored by a dramatic marble TV wall — fluted panels, warm wood media console, and soft peach tones create an inviting focal point.

chapters.title: Minimalist Lounge
chapters.text: Clean lines and a neutral palette define this serene lounge — leather seating, stone accents, and natural light in perfect balance.

chapters.title: Double-Height Living
chapters.text: Soaring ceilings and floor-to-ceiling drapes flood this double-height space with light — two-tone sofas and a ribbed timber coffee table complete the scene.

chapters.title: Stone Craft
chapters.text: Every junction tells a story — large-format stone slabs with precise dry-cladding clips, where materiality becomes architecture.

chapters.title: TV Wall Design
chapters.text: Fluted panels meet veined marble in a TV wall composition that balances warmth, texture, and contemporary restraint.

chapters.title: Kitchen & Dining
chapters.text: A lavender-toned kitchen with gold accents — bespoke cabinetry, polished surfaces, and a dining set designed for everyday elegance.

chapters.title: Custom Storage
chapters.text: Floor-to-ceiling taupe cabinetry with mirrored jaali panels — storage that doubles as sculpture in a refined dining environment.

chapters.title: Jaali & Staircase
chapters.text: Traditional jaali screens meet modern glass-and-timber staircases — heritage motifs woven into contemporary open-plan living.

chapters.title: Terracotta Living
chapters.text: A burnt-orange Chesterfield anchors this living room — fluted walls, wood ceiling coffers, and a window nook designed for quiet moments.

chapters.title: Material Palette
chapters.text: Stone, wood, and fluted panel in dialogue — a TV wall where every surface is chosen for tactile richness and visual calm.

chapters.title: Chesterfield Suite
chapters.text: Tufted velvet, glossy white tables, and layered neutrals — a living suite where comfort and sophistication coexist effortlessly.

chapters.title: Study Nook
chapters.text: A floating desk, curved shelf, and mandala-etched wardrobe panels — a workspace designed for focus within a calming interior world.

title: Commercial & Residential Building
description: A bold mixed-use development for Mr. Akshay Gavli — combining ground-floor retail with upper-level residences. Clean volumes, vertical louvers, integrated planters, and a marble-accented top floor define this Sangli landmark.

title: Residence for Mr. Sudhakar Ruknar
description: A bold expression of modern living — clean volumes, warm wooden accents, and layered roof overhangs with integrated lighting define this contemporary Pandharpur residence.

title: Residence for Mr. Khatake
description: Organic curves meet geometric precision — arched windows, a sculptural funnel column, and warm stone cladding create a residence that feels both grounded and aspirational.

title: Kanchan Residence
description: Your facade is not just what people see — it is what they feel before stepping inside. A completed residence featuring geometric screens, layered volumes, and warm natural light.

title: Contemporary Living Room
description: Marble-feature TV wall with fluted panels, warm wood finishes, and open-plan living — where every piece tells a story and every space invites you to stay.

title: Luxury Jewellery Showroom
description: At Yogesh Chavan Associates, we design jewellery spaces where luxury meets functionality — circular display niches, gold accents, and ambient chandelier lighting.

title: Multi-Storey Commercial Tower
description: A tall commercial tower rising in urban Sangli — raw concrete form giving way to a landmark mixed-use destination.

title: Farmhouse Retreat for CA Ram Patil
description: A peaceful escape taking shape — terracotta roof tiles, open verandahs, and a rural setting reimagined as a weekend farmhouse retreat.
